'''Serjil Javis'''<ref name="Follow">{{TORcite|type=message|FW: Follow-up on Karrels Javis|Watcher Three}}</ref> was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who was a son of [[Karrels Javis]], a [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] of [[Suudaa Nem'ro]]. In [[3643 BBY]], Serjil and his brother [[Vargai Javis|Vargai]] encountered a [[Unidentified Sith apprentice (Karrels Javis's sons)|Sith apprentice]] in Imperial space and a dispute broke out. The [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] killed Serjil and crippled Vargai, and the incident disrupted an [[Imperial Intelligence (Sith Empire)|Imperial Intelligence]] operation involving Karrels Javis, resulting in Karrels's [[Death/Legends|death]] shortly after learning what happened.<ref name="Change of Plans" />
